name: image-kg
description: Wtr.Vision-KG — Image-to-Knowledge-Graph service. Ingests a single image, extracts objects + relationships with GPT-5 Vision (open AI-chosen category/name + full provenance), and writes a deterministic, MERGE-based graph into the co-located wtrdb-v2 FalkorDB + Postgres so it is viewable/queryable in v2's existing UI. Does NOT modify v2.
